_source: Coaches (decided Oct 7: 4 types - goalkeeper, defence, midfield, forward; stats and a contract with limited seasons; one-time contract price, no wages; you pick which players each coach trains and each player's regime; one coach per player; fewer players per coach = faster growth; the Training Grounds level sets how many coaches you can have, up to one per player in theory; ex-players can become coaches, cheaper at their old clubs; rarely a former player joins for free. Carlos Oct 9: coaches speed training up, but every player develops naturally). Numbers are PROPOSALS (Oct 9 night).
_growthNote: Weekly growth multiplier: with a coach = (0.5 + rating/100) x crowd, crowd = 1 / (1 + 0.08 x (players on him - 1)); without a coach = 0.6 (natural development). A 50-rated coach with 7 players gives about 0.68, like the default before coaches existed, so the world's balance holds when AI clubs have about one coach per group.
_limitNote: Coaches a club can have = 3 x the Training Grounds working level (rounded, at least 1): level 1 = 3, level 5 = 15, level 10 = 30 (about one per player).
_priceNote: Contract price per season of contract (EUR, the same for every club): 25,000 x 1.1^(rating - 40). Rating 50 = 65K, 60 = 168K, 70 = 436K, 80 = 1.1M, 90 = 2.9M. Ex-players are 30% cheaper at a club they played for.
_poolNote: World: every club starts with one coach per group (rating from its reputation); a free pool of about 150 coaches. Each season retired players (15%) become coaches, new coaches are generated to keep the pool at 150, and coaches age and retire (60-72).
_surpriseNote: Rarely (2% per club per season) a former player of the club joins as a coach for free.
_aiNote: AI clubs: keep a coach for each group, plus more for bigger clubs (reputation 60+: 6, 80+: 8), within their Training Grounds limit; each coach costs at most 3% of the club's money; contracts are renewed when they still fit the budget. Players are shared evenly between the coaches of their group, youngest first.
